d.ko: A multiplayer FPS where you eliminate opponents by typing the numbers on their foreheads. Read theirs before they read yours, use tactical gadgets to disrupt the fight, and battle friends or strangers in matches with up to 20 players.

d.zh: 一款通过输入对手额头上的数字来淘汰对手的多人 FPS。抢先读出他们的数字，别让他们先看清你的。利用战术道具打乱战局，与好友或陌生玩家展开最多 20 人的对战。
